plain.zh: 設計 AI 運算晶片的美國公司，是整個 AI 江湖的中心。
plain.en: The US company designing the chips that power AI — the center of the whole jianghu.

plain.zh: NVIDIA 的軟體工具，讓工程師能用 GPU 做運算。大家的程式都用它寫，所以很難換別家的晶片。
plain.en: NVIDIA's software toolkit for programming GPUs. So much code is written with it that switching chips is hard.

plain.zh: 原本用來畫遊戲畫面的晶片，因為能同時做很多計算，變成 AI 最重要的運算工具。
plain.en: A chip first built for game graphics; because it does many calculations at once, it became AI's key tool.

plain.zh: 電腦的運算能力。AI 越大，需要的內力越多。
plain.en: Raw computing capacity. Bigger AI needs more of it.

plain.zh: 用大量資料和算力，讓 AI 學會本事，通常要花好幾個月與大筆金錢。
plain.en: Feeding AI huge amounts of data and compute until it learns — often months and big money.

plain.zh: AI 學成之後，實際回答你的問題、幫你做事的過程。
plain.en: When a trained AI actually answers you or does a task.

real.zh: 資料中心 / AI 工廠

plain.zh: 擺滿伺服器的超大機房。專門跑 AI 的機房，NVIDIA 稱為「AI 工廠」。
plain.en: A huge building full of servers. One built just for AI is what NVIDIA calls an "AI factory".

plain.zh: 不只會聊天，還會自己規劃步驟、操作工具、替你跑腿辦事的 AI。
plain.en: AI that doesn't just chat — it plans steps, uses tools and runs errands for you.

plain.zh: 像 AWS、Google Cloud 這種把電腦放在網路上出租的大公司。
plain.en: Giants like AWS or Google Cloud that rent computers over the internet.

plain.zh: 專門研發最先進 AI 模型的頂尖團隊。
plain.en: Top teams building the most advanced AI models.

plain.zh: 從第一天起就以 AI 為核心的新創公司。
plain.en: Startups built around AI from day one.

plain.zh: 專門出租 GPU 給 AI 公司的新型雲端業者。
plain.en: Newer cloud companies that specialize in renting GPUs to AI teams.

plain.zh: OEM 是用自己品牌賣機器的廠商；ODM 是幫別人設計並製造的代工廠。兩者都把晶片組成伺服器。
plain.en: OEMs sell machines under their own brand; ODMs design and build for others. Both turn chips into servers.

plain.zh: 各行各業的公司，把 AI 用在自己的業務上。
plain.en: Companies in every industry applying AI to their own business.

plain.zh: NVIDIA 2026 年推出的開源軟體，把 AI Agent 關在「沙盒」裡照規矩辦事，降低它亂來的風險。
plain.en: Open-source software NVIDIA launched in 2026 that runs AI agents inside a rule-bound sandbox to reduce the risk of them going rogue.

plain.zh: 伺服器是專門處理運算的電腦；很多台疊在一個櫃子裡，就叫機架。
plain.en: A server is a computer built for heavy work; stack many in a cabinet and you have a rack.

plain.zh: AI 學成的「本事」本身，例如 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 背後的大腦。
plain.en: The learned skill itself — the brain behind ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

plain.zh: 讀過海量文字、很會理解和產生文字的 AI 模型。
plain.en: An AI model trained on oceans of text that's great at reading and writing.

plain.zh: 電力單位。1 GW 大約是一座大型發電廠的發電量，現在常用來形容 AI 機房有多大。
plain.en: A unit of power — about one big power plant's output. Now a common way to size AI data centers.

plain.zh: 用液體帶走晶片熱量的散熱方式，比吹風扇更有效。
plain.en: Cooling chips with liquid instead of fans — far more effective.

plain.zh: NVIDIA 2024 年發表的一代 GPU 架構名稱。
plain.en: The NVIDIA GPU generation unveiled in 2024.

plain.zh: 接在 Blackwell 之後的下一代 NVIDIA 平台。
plain.en: NVIDIA's next platform after Blackwell.

plain.zh: 公開讓大家下載、自己架設使用的 AI 模型。
plain.en: AI models anyone can download and run themselves.

plain.zh: 一個國家或地區想用自己掌握的機房和模型發展 AI，不完全依賴外國公司。
plain.en: A country building AI on data centers and models it controls, not relying fully on foreign firms.

plain.zh: 剛成立、想快速成長的小公司。
plain.en: A young company aiming to grow fast.

plain.zh: 出錢換一部分公司股份。NVIDIA 投資了很多自家客戶。
plain.en: Putting in money for a share of a company. NVIDIA has invested in many of its own customers.

plain.zh: 保護電腦和資料不被駭客入侵。
plain.en: Protecting computers and data from hackers.

plain.zh: 只為特定工作設計的晶片，例如 Google TPU、AWS Trainium。通常比 GPU 省電、便宜，但彈性較低。
plain.en: A chip designed for one job, like Google's TPU or AWS Trainium — often cheaper and more efficient than GPUs, but less flexible.

plain.zh: NVIDIA 的高速連線技術，讓多顆 GPU 像一顆大 GPU 一樣快速交換資料。
plain.en: NVIDIA's high-speed link that lets many GPUs share data so fast they act like one big GPU.

plain.zh: 把壞指令藏在 AI 會讀到的網頁、Email 或文件裡，騙 AI 照著做。是 AI Agent 最大的資安風險之一。
plain.en: Hiding malicious instructions in web pages, emails or files an AI reads, tricking it into obeying. One of the biggest risks for AI agents.

plain.zh: 用電腦模擬產生的資料，用來訓練 AI。適合真實資料難取得、牽涉隱私或危險的情況。
plain.en: Data generated by simulation to train AI — useful when real data is scarce, private or dangerous to collect.

plain.zh: AI 模型學到的知識，存成一大堆數字。參數越多，模型通常越大、越強，也越吃算力。
plain.en: What a model has learned, stored as a vast set of numbers. More parameters usually means a bigger, stronger, hungrier model.

plain.zh: AI 讀寫文字的最小單位，大約是一個中文字或半個英文單字。AI 服務常按 token 數量收費。
plain.en: The smallest unit of text an AI reads or writes — roughly one Chinese character or about three-quarters of an English word. AI services often charge per token.

plain.zh: 拿已經訓練好的模型，再用特定領域的資料加強訓練，讓它更懂某個專業。
plain.en: Taking a trained model and training it further on specialist data so it masters a particular field.

plain.zh: 一個被隔離的執行環境。AI Agent 在裡面做事，就算出錯也不會影響外面的系統。
plain.en: An isolated environment where an AI agent can work without harming outside systems if something goes wrong.

plain.zh: 疊在 GPU 旁邊的高速記憶體。AI 模型很大，GPU 能多快拿到資料，常常和算得多快一樣重要。
plain.en: Stacked high-speed memory beside the GPU. AI models are huge, so how fast the GPU can fetch data often matters as much as raw speed.

real.en: L6 / L10 / L11 / L12 (server build levels)

plain.zh: 伺服器代工交貨時做到哪一步：L6 主機板裝進機殼；L10 完整可開機的伺服器；L11 整個機櫃組好並測試；L12 多櫃串成叢集並驗證軟體。各廠定義略有差異。
plain.en: How complete a server delivery is: L6 board in chassis; L10 a complete, bootable server; L11 a fully built and tested rack; L12 multiple racks validated as a cluster. Definitions vary slightly by maker.

plain.zh: 客戶自己買好關鍵零件交給代工廠組裝。代工廠帳上營收會變少，但出貨量和獲利不一定變少。
plain.en: The customer buys key parts and hands them to the manufacturer to assemble. Reported revenue drops, but shipments and profit may not.

plain.zh: 學會「世界怎麼運作」的 AI，能預測動作的後果，用於機器人、自駕車與模擬環境。
plain.en: AI that learns how the world works and predicts the results of actions — used in robots, self-driving and simulation.

plain.zh: 從一片雜訊開始，一步步「去雜訊」生成圖片、影片或文字的 AI 方法。
plain.en: An AI method that starts from noise and removes it step by step to generate images, video or text.

plain.zh: 先找出相關文件，再讓 AI 根據這些資料回答，答案有出處、比較不會亂編。
plain.en: Find relevant documents first, then let the AI answer from them — grounded, citable, less made-up.

plain.zh: AI 一本正經地講出不存在或錯誤的內容，例如捏造引用。
plain.en: When AI confidently states false or nonexistent things, like fabricated citations.

wuxia.en: Eye, Word and Hand as One

real.zh: VLA 模型（視覺－語言－動作）

plain.zh: 讓機器人同時看懂畫面、聽懂指令並輸出動作的 AI 模型。
plain.en: An AI model letting robots see, understand instructions and output actions together.

plain.zh: AI 透過嘗試、獎勵與懲罰學會最好策略的方法，AlphaGo 就是經典例子。
plain.en: Learning the best strategy through trial, reward and penalty — AlphaGo is the classic example.

plain.zh: 模型裡有很多「專家」，每次只叫醒最相關的幾位來算，大而省。
plain.en: A model with many experts that wakes only the relevant few per answer — big yet efficient.

plain.zh: 凍結原模型、只訓練一小組額外參數的微調方法，便宜又快。
plain.en: A fine-tuning method that freezes the model and trains a small add-on set of parameters — cheap and fast.

plain.zh: 比較不同 AI 表現的標準考題；獨立、可重現的測試最可信。
plain.en: A standard test for comparing AIs; independent, reproducible tests are most credible.

plain.zh: ARR（年度經常性收入）是把目前有效的訂閱合約換算成一年的金額；新創常說的「年化營收（run-rate）」則多半是最近一個月營收 ×12。兩者都反映成長動能，但都不是審計過的全年營收。
plain.en: ARR (annual recurring revenue) is the yearly value of active subscription contracts; a startup 'run-rate' usually means latest month's revenue × 12. Both show momentum, but neither is audited annual revenue.

plain.zh: 用自然語言描述需求，讓 AI 生成程式，人只負責檢查與調整。
plain.en: Describing what you want in plain language and letting AI write the code while you review.

plain.zh: 在電腦裡建一個和真實產品或工廠一模一樣、遵守物理定律的模型，先模擬再動工。
plain.en: A physics-faithful virtual copy of a real product or factory, used to simulate before building.

plain.zh: 專門處理網路、加密與資安檢查的處理器，例如 NVIDIA BlueField，替 CPU、GPU 分擔雜務。
plain.en: A processor for networking, encryption and security checks — like NVIDIA BlueField — offloading chores from CPUs and GPUs.

plain.zh: 每一次存取都驗證身分與權限，不因為「在內部」就被信任。
plain.en: Verify identity and permission on every access — nobody is trusted just for being inside.

plain.zh: 自動安排、重啟、擴充大量軟體容器的系統，雲端與 AI 服務廣泛使用。
plain.en: A system that schedules, restarts and scales many software containers — widely used for cloud and AI services.

plain.zh: 把財務、採購、生產、庫存、人資整合在一起的企業核心系統。
plain.en: The core business system unifying finance, purchasing, production, inventory and HR.
